_ordering_rationale: KPIs operationnels specifiques homebuilder #1 US. Homes Closed = volume hero, ASP = pricing, Backlog = visibilite future, Gross Margin = profitabilite cycle, Net Sales Orders = demand signal, Rental ops = diversification.

kpis.signal: #1 homebuilder US par volume, baisse FY25 sur fond taux eleves
kpis.description_fr: Nombre de maisons livrees par les operations homebuilding. KPI hero du #1 builder US (126 marches, 36 etats). FY25 termine 30 sep 2025.
kpis.description_en: Homes closed by homebuilding operations. Hero KPI of #1 US homebuilder (126 markets, 36 states). FY25 ending Sep 30 2025.

kpis.signal: Pricing modere par incentives (rate buydowns) et mix entry-level
kpis.description_fr: Prix moyen de vente d'une maison livree. Baisse 2% FY25 due aux sales incentives (mortgage rate buydowns) pour soutenir la demande.
kpis.description_en: Average closing price per home. Down 2% FY25 due to sales incentives (mortgage rate buydowns) supporting affordability.

kpis.signal: Visibilite revenue FY26, contraction 5e annee consecutive (peak 2021)
kpis.description_fr: Valeur des contrats de vente non encore clotures au 30 sep. Backlog FY25 = 10 785 maisons / 4.1 Mds $. Contraction depuis peak FY21.
kpis.description_en: Value of sales contracts not yet closed at Sep 30. FY25 backlog = 10,785 homes / $4.1B. Compressing since FY21 peak.

kpis.signal: Compression sur cycle taux, retour vers normalisation historique
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute sur ventes de maisons. Peak FY22 28.7% (housing boom), compression continue jusqu'a 21.5% FY25 sur incentives eleves.
kpis.description_en: Gross margin on home sales. Peak FY22 28.7% (housing boom), continuous compression to 21.5% FY25 on elevated incentives.

kpis.signal: Demande FY25 -4% YoY, valeur orders 30.8 Mds $ -6%
kpis.description_fr: Nouvelles commandes nettes (gross orders moins cancellations). Cancellation rate FY25 = 18% (stable vs FY24). Indicateur avance de revenus futurs.
kpis.description_en: New net sales orders (gross orders minus cancellations). FY25 cancellation rate = 18% (stable vs FY24). Leading indicator of future revenue.

kpis.signal: DHI Rental build-to-rent en contraction post peak FY23 (6 175 unites)
kpis.description_fr: Maisons single-family construites puis vendues en bloc a des investisseurs locatifs. Segment Rental complementaire au homebuilding core.
kpis.description_en: Single-family homes built and sold in bulk to rental investors. Rental segment complementary to core homebuilding.
